# Copilot instructions

Guidance for this repository lives in [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md). Read it — it is the
single source, and this file is only a pointer so that GitHub Copilot in VS Code and on
github.com finds it.

Path-scoped rules live in `.github/instructions/*.instructions.md`. Repository-specific
skills live in `.github/skills/`. Do not duplicate guidance here.
